svg.aria-label: Three-arm AdamW rotation test: unconstrained LoRA, gradient-projected LoRA and ProjectThenHealLinear leakage into span(D) over 60 steps on three models, plus the 15-model H100 Stage-1 three-arm run
svg.text: THREE-ARM ROTATION TEST · REAL LAYER-16 DOWN_PROJ · k = 3 · LoRA RANK 16 · ADAMW lr 3e-3 · 3 SEEDS
Projecting the gradient leaks under AdamW. Projecting the weights does not.
Leakage lk_W = ‖D·ΔW‖_F / ‖ΔW‖_F, log scale. Orthogonal target (entirely outside span(D)), weight decay 0.0.
Line = mean of 3 seeds, band = seed min to max. Synthetic regression on a real edited writer, not language-model fine-tuning.
Step-60 mean of 3 seeds, orthogonal target, wd 0.0. Arms A and B are identical at step 1: the gradient already lies outside span(D),
so the projection does nothing, and AdamW's per-coordinate g/(|g|+ε) step is what rotates arm B into span(D).
Arm C ends with arm A's training loss; arm B ends with a higher loss than both.
Step 60, both targets, both weight decays
filled = wd 0.0 · ring = wd 0.01 · mixed target floor 0.25
H100 Stage-1: 15 models, all three arms, step 60
one metric for every arm · ● A ◆ B ● C · 1 seed
Here B sits below A on 15 of 15 models, the reverse of the mixed-target rows; it never
reaches C: min B / max C = 3.8e+06. Target: orthogonal MSE + real-token CE.
Sources: posthoc_lr3e-3_run_{q35_08b 3ee4aa43, q35_4b db193e05, q25_7b c7bba16e}.json (mixed-target rows; lr 3e-3 is post hoc, the preregistered
lr 1e-2 run gives the same ordering) · irrefutable-15models-stage1-receipt.json 00f4fe2a (H100 Stage-1, seed 20261105).
